items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: We know him. He is to play with Freddie.

ctx.x: He gave up the violin. He gave up the violin. When did he play on the mandolin? He said he was the first.

Then he played on the mandolin a little bit, but he wasn't playing with no band with the mandolin. But he could play. And he also was playing card then. I guess you know something about the card, Mr. Roussel. Sure. That card with that pull out and push in. The squeeze box. And then Manuel Manetta still is the first.
Manuel Manetta, that is his best friend.
